fato_historico: 1957: Pamir, a four-masted barque, was shipwrecked and sank off the Azores during Hurricane Carrie.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to embrace your inner roar today. Much like a sturdy ship navigating through turbulent storms, you may find that your resilience is your greatest anchor when currents pull. Consider this a time to steady your sails, trust in your own navigation skills, and emerge from the metaphorical waves with grace, strength, and renewed purpose.
frase_do_dia: True strength shines brightest after the most challenging storms.
significado_numero: Represents the potential for success and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Trust your intuition and keep your gaze fixed on your bright horizon.
